verses.text: I lift up my eyes to you, you who sit in the heavens.
lines: I lift up my eyes to you,
you who sit in the heavens.

verses.text: Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress; so our eyes look to Yahweh, our God, until he has mercy on us.
lines: Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master,
as the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress;
so our eyes look to Yahweh, our God,
until he has mercy on us.

verses.text: Have mercy on us, Yahweh, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt.
lines: Have mercy on us, Yahweh, have mercy on us,
for we have endured much contempt.

verses.text: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.
lines: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease,
with the contempt of the proud.
